# Dahua P2P tunnel (vendored)

Based on [khoanguyen-3fc/dh-p2p](https://github.com/khoanguyen-3fc/dh-p2p) (proof of concept).
Used by CarTrack to reach Dahua Hero cameras via Easy4IP cloud when `connection_mode` is `p2p`.

**Note:** Unofficial reverse-engineered protocol; may break with firmware updates.
